name: claude-hook-audit
description: Retrospective hook profiler for Claude Code. Reads the durationMs that Claude Code already writes to session transcripts, so no wrapper has to be installed in front of your hooks first.

plugins.name: hook-audit
plugins.description: Profile Claude Code hooks from transcripts that already exist. Ranks hooks by main-session blocking time, separates subagent runs, finds hangs, timeouts and blocked tool calls.
